items.title: Russian military analysis reports increased Ukrainian activity near Sumy
items.summary: A Russian battlefield assessment says Ukrainian small-unit activity has intensified along the Khoten-Mohrytsya line north of Sumy, with troops reportedly infiltrating forested areas rather than mounting a large offensive. It warns that a buildup could threaten Russian positions and potentially lead to operations toward the border.

items.title: Russia says artillery struck Ukrainian drone-control posts in Kharkiv region
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry said a Giatsint-B artillery crew from its Sever Group shelled Ukrainian drone-control positions, equipment and personnel in Kharkiv region. The announcement did not specify the exact location or provide a damage assessment.
